description: Render the run a session recorded as a state timeline or a message sequence (%render-run), in a text, diagram or SVG form. Recording must be on before the run: repl_command `%trace on`.

form.description: text (default), mermaid, plantuml, svg (a self-contained SVG drawing) or svg-animated (the SVG replaying the run with SMIL)

kind.description: timeline (state occupancy per object machine over clock time) or sequence (the messages sent)

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: render_run

rendering.description: the rendering as data: lanes with their state spans, transitions and marks for a timeline; nodes and edges for a sequence

text.description: the rendering in the form asked for

until.description: the clock instant the rendering runs through
